A Heart-Healthy Recipe from the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute Prep time: 5 minutes Cook time: 0 minutes Total time: 5 minutes Number of Servings: 4 Children love the creamy sweet taste of this drink. Ingredients 2 cup low-fat (1 percent) milk 4 Tbsp frozen mango juice (or 1 fresh pitted mango) 1 small banana 2 ice cubes Directions Put all ingredients into a blender. Blend until foamy. Serve immediately. Variations: Instead of mango juice, try orange juice, papaya, or strawberries.
